Additional names include ''Ajokoot'', ''Croker Island'', ''[[Raffles Bay]]'', ''Terrutong'' (''Terutong''), ''Yaako'' (''Jaako, Yako''). ==Classification== Marrgu had been assumed to be an [[Iwaidjan language]] like its neighbours.
